spec.modal_formula: Integral |Delta E|^2 dx dz=L/|gamma|^2 [t|Delta q0|^2+sum_n tanh(kn*t)/kn (|Delta q+|^2+|Delta q-|^2)]; missing signed coefficients are zero
spec.modal_RMS: sqrt(Integral |Delta E|^2/(2*L*t)); relative error uses the new finite-series field norm; no gauge/phase fit
spec.contact_primary: Exact physical interval-pair length weighted complex L2; temporal RMS is peak-complex spatial norm/sqrt(2); relative uses max(old,new) spatial norm
spec.contact_secondary: Covered-length average onto old panels before norm, explicitly labelled averaging; never replaces primary pairwise norm
spec.power: Contact S=.5*zA*integral |q|^2 dl, W/m out-of-plane; signed new-minus-old complex difference preserved
spec.original_flags: All original sampled-grid/delta flags and values are retained separately and unchanged; new modal flags do not clear or overwrite them

analytic_contract.quadrature: 32x32 Gauss-Legendre, independent direct constant-plus-single-cosine Ex/Ez integration

limitations: Exact modal integration refers only to each stored finite Fourier field, not the unknown continuum solution
Native panel q and truncated Fourier top q are distinct; panel contact loss and modal bulk loss must not be interchanged
Transferred surrogate coefficients do not verify actual skin contact, anatomy, TIS, activation, safety or experiment

exact_modal_vector_field.denominator: New finite-series vector carrier RMS L2; floor1e-300 V/m

physical_native_panel_contact.endpoint_policy: Validate both physical endpoints, then canonicalize them to the fixed contact within tolerance
physical_native_panel_contact.quantile_definition: Length-weighted empirical magnitude quantile: smallest value whose cumulative contact length reaches 95%; no interpolation
physical_native_panel_contact.power_definition: Peak phasors: complex S per unit out-of-plane width =0.5*zA*integral(abs(q)^2 dl); active power=real(S)
physical_native_panel_contact.current_definition: Caller-supplied complex peak normal current density; temporal RMS magnitudes divide by sqrt(2)
physical_native_panel_contact.projection_warning: Averaging can hide panel-scale variation; physical pairwise comparison is primary

secondary.definition: B length-averaged onto covered old panels; secondary only

pairs.raw_contact_pairwise_difference_conventi: old A minus new B; norm is invariant to this sign, while modal coefficients are new minus old

sampled_vector_field.scope: Original stored fixed512x128-grid diagnostic copied unchanged, not recomputed or replaced
